[EN] Mission Orders

The Batia's Hulk sailors have turned into undead and are attacking passersby in the area.

Eliminate the {@LinkCreature:31#12#drowned gula sailors}, {@LinkCreature:31#13#swabs}, {@LinkCreature:31#14#bosuns}, and {@LinkCreature:31#15#officers}.

Report to Celion when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los marineros del Batia's Hulk se han convertido en muertos vivientes y están atacando a los transeúntes en la zona.

Elimina a los {@LinkCreature:31#12#drowned gula sailors}, {@LinkCreature:31#13#swabs}, {@LinkCreature:31#14#bosuns} y {@LinkCreature:31#15#officers}.

Preséntate ante Celion cuando completes la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
